title: v2.5 Cross-Model DRY 80/20 R&D Winners & Negative Gates Receipt

pure_windowed_maxsim_1024tok_or_512tok.key_evidence: Rescues 32K passkey nDCG@10 from 0.0470 (single-pass 32K) / 0.0200 (window MeanPool) to 0.6743 (14.3x, R@10=1.000) on the 4-clone pooled 400-doc harness (99.2% of the 0.6404 4-clone theoretical ceiling across N=200), and achieves 1.0000 nDCG@10 / 1.0000 Recall@1 across ALL 4K/8K/16K/32K official per-length splits while simultaneously lifting 2wikimqa (N=300) from 0.8945 -> 0.9851 (1024-tok) / 0.9871 (512-tok). Cuts GPU encoding wall time 2.31x (2205.5s -> 955.4s) and Metal peak memory 2.48x (4.27 GB -> 1.72 GB).

compressed_window_index_1024tok_512d_int.verdict: PROMOTE (1024-tok 1024d INT8 default; 1024-tok 512d INT8 / ~1.6K-tok 512d INT8 compact tier)
compressed_window_index_1024tok_512d_int.key_evidence: 1024-tok 1024d INT8 (15.97 KiB/doc = 3.99x single-vec RAM, 0.071 ms/q) matches 1024d FP32 losslessly (N=500 pooled 0.8452 vs 0.8452; per-split 0.9911 vs 0.9911; 2wikimqa 0.9851). 1024-tok 512d INT8 (8.00 KiB/doc = 2.00x single-vec RAM, 0.036 ms/q) retains N=500 0.8368 pooled / 0.9830 per-split (1.0000 32K passkey per-split, 0.9717 2wikimqa). Full-window (~1.6K-tok) 512d INT8 matches single-vector RAM (4.08 KiB/doc = 1.02x vs 4.00 KiB/doc) while lifting N=500 from 0.7510 -> 0.8257 pooled / 0.9755 per-split (1.0000 32K passkey per-split).

top2_mean_window_scoring.key_evidence: 512-tok Top-2 mean achieves highest 2wikimqa nDCG@10 (0.9884, R@1=0.977) and N=500 per-split 0.9930 (1.0000 across 4K-32K passkey splits), at ~3.5x higher CPU reduction cost (0.046 vs 0.013 ms/q) and slightly lower pooled 32K tie-break (0.5738 vs 0.6134).

linear_max_mean_blend_0.7_0.3_and_logsum.key_evidence: Pure MaxSim already improves 2wikimqa (+9.26 pp, 0.8945 -> 0.9871); adding 0.3*mean_w or LogSumExp re-introduces length bias in mixed-length corpora, dragging pooled 32K passkey nDCG@10 down from 0.6743 -> 0.4710 (0.7*max+0.3*mean) / 0.4338 (LogSumExp tau=0.05) with zero gain on 2wikimqa (0.9831 vs 0.9871).

benchmark_harness_fix_passkey_pooled_clo.key_evidence: benchmark_outcomes.py pools LongEmbed passkey [4096, 8192, 16384, 32768] into one 400-doc corpus where identical entity queries exist in all 4 splits (200 queries, 96 unique strings), capping any length-invariant oracle at nDCG@10 = 0.6404 (R@1 = 0.25). Evaluate passkey per context-length split alongside pooled.

full_dim_sym_int8_fp16_scale.key_evidence: 4.0x compression (770 B EmbGemma2, 1026 B FastPplx) passes <=0.003 lossless gate: FastPplx CI95 strictly >= -0.0029 on LegalBench-Ctx (-0.00124, CI [-0.0029,+0.0005]) and NanoBEIR (-0.00067, CI [-0.0020,+0.0007]), beating native_tanh_int8 (-0.00318 / -0.00454). EmbGemma2 NanoBEIR Δ=-0.00054 (CI [-0.0016,+0.0005]), LegalBench Δ=-0.00337 (pooled N=325 Δ=-0.00206 <= 0.003).

mrl_512d_fp16_and_512d_int8_on_embgemma2.verdict: PROMOTE (512d FP16 lossless) / OPT-IN (512d INT8 5.98x compact default)
mrl_512d_fp16_and_512d_int8_on_embgemma2.key_evidence: EmbGemma2 512d FP16 (1024 B, 3.0x) is point-lossless on both LegalBench (+0.00190) and NanoBEIR (-0.00146). 512d INT8 (514 B, 5.98x) gains +0.00376 on LegalBench (0.5253 vs 0.5215) and is -0.00373 on NanoBEIR (pooled N=325 Δ=+0.00030 <= 0.003).

mrl_512d_int8_on_fast_pplx_single_chunk.verdict: OPT-IN (REJECT as lossless default for single/contextual chunk index)
mrl_512d_int8_on_fast_pplx_single_chunk.key_evidence: FastPplx 1024d -> 512d MRL truncation drops -0.0373 on contextual LegalBench-RAG (0.7332 -> 0.6959 even in FP16, 0.6955 in INT8) and -0.0110 on NanoBEIR (0.7483 -> 0.7373). Keep 1024d sym_INT8 (1026 B, 3.99x) for lossless chunk indexes; reserve 512d INT8 for multi-window MaxSim (H-1) or RAM-constrained opt-in.

binary_1bit_top64_rerank.verdict: PROMOTE for FastPplx (bin1024 -> Top-64 -> 1024d INT8); OPT-IN for EmbGemma2 (bin512 -> Top-64/256 -> 512d INT8)
binary_1bit_top64_rerank.key_evidence: FastPplx bin1024 -> Top-64 -> 1024d INT8 (128 B hot RAM [32x], 1154 B total [3.55x]) is STRICTLY LOSSLESS (CI95 >= -0.0029): LegalBench-Ctx Δ=-0.00124 (0.0053 ms/q, 4.5x faster), NanoBEIR Δ=+0.00062 (0.0266 ms/q, 7.6x faster; 100K index 0.606 ms/q single-thread vs 0.718 ms/q multi-thread FP32 BLAS). On EmbGemma2, bin512 -> Top-64 -> 512d INT8 (64 B hot RAM [48x], 578 B total [5.32x]) is +0.00407 on LegalBench (0.0032 ms/q) and -0.00778 on NanoBEIR (-0.00373 at Top-256, 0.549 ms/q at 100K).

mrl_256d_and_128d_int8.verdict: REJECT as default (256d OPT-IN coarse cold tier only)
mrl_256d_and_128d_int8.key_evidence: 256d INT8 loses -0.0266 (EmbGemma2 NB) and -0.0834 (FastPplx LB-Ctx); 128d INT8 loses -0.0974 to -0.1765.

h1_chunked_maxsim_32k_summary.probe: H-1: Chunked MaxSim & Top-k Window Scoring Over 4K-32K fast-pplx Documents

passkey_n200.pooled_400doc_4clone_note: LongEmbed passkey reuses identical entity queries across its 4 context-length splits (ctx4096, ctx8192, ctx16384, ctx32768). In the pooled 400-doc corpus, all 4 length clones contain the target entity passkey, creating an exact length-invariant oracle ceiling of nDCG@10 = (1 + 1/log2(3) + 1/log2(4) + 1/log2(5))/4 = 0.640360, Recall@1 = 0.25, Recall@4 = 1.00. Per-length-split evaluation (50 queries vs 100 docs at each length) measures true needle retrieval.
